column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 08 (M24008): pertempuran di dek berakhir dengan pintu Nirvana
# terbuka; Commander dibanjiri ingatan dari garis waktu lain.
# Tetap Inggris: AR Team, Beluga, Ateraxis, The Elmo, Mayling, Chiloveig, Barracuda,
# Colphne, Frame, Nyto, Red Zone, Groza, Zucchero Squad, AR-15, Springfield, Helena,
# Peritya, Yoohee, Florence, Peri, Qiuhua, Dandelion, Melanie, Jojo, Doll, Commander.

(It seemed that with every person who returned, the AR Team's tactical efficiency and coordination improved. After Beluga appeared, Ateraxis's responses became more cautious and lethal, as if she too felt some kind of threat.)
column2: (Sepertinya setiap kali satu orang kembali, efisiensi taktis dan koordinasi AR Team ikut naik. Setelah Beluga muncul, respons Ateraxis jadi lebih hati-hati dan lebih mematikan, seolah dia pun merasakan semacam ancaman.)

column1: (The chainsaw sword clashed against Ateraxis's energy shield, biting through it with astonishing momentum. Ateraxis swung her long blade to deflect Beluga's continuous slashes, and her counterattack was—for the first time—blocked by her opponent.)
column2: (Pedang bergerigi rantai itu berbenturan dengan pelindung energi Ateraxis, menggigitnya tembus dengan momentum yang mencengangkan. Ateraxis mengayunkan bilah panjangnya untuk menangkis tebasan Beluga yang datang terus, dan serangan balasnya—untuk pertama kalinya—ditahan lawannya.)

column1: —As expected of...
column2: —Memang pantas disebut...

column1: No need for pleasantries, just go die properly!
column2: Tidak perlu basa-basi, mati saja dengan benar!

column1: (The dragon, whose body was constantly twisting and mutating, and eventually even began tearing at the Elmo, could no longer effectively organize an offensive due to its physical changes, and was merely enduring more firepower from the AR Team.)
column2: (Naga yang tubuhnya terus memutar dan bermutasi, sampai akhirnya mulai mencabik Elmo, tidak lagi bisa menyusun serangan yang efektif karena perubahan fisiknya, dan hanya menanggung lebih banyak daya tembak dari AR Team.)

column1: Damn it... the progress is much slower than expected. Is little flower still resisting? Or is it because those Dolls are here... Uh, eehhh?!
column2: Sialan... progresnya jauh lebih lambat dari perkiraan. Apa bunga kecil itu masih melawan? Atau karena Doll-Doll itu ada di sini... Eh, eeeh?!

column1: The Elmo is starting to move!
column2: The Elmo mulai bergerak!

column1: Is it Mayling—!
column2: Itu Mayling—!

column1: (The sudden departure of the vehicle causes everyone except Ateraxis and Beluga to stumble. The two of them seem to transcend the effects of Earth's gravity and inertia, exchanging offensive and defensive maneuvers with flowing movements that the other Dolls cannot even capture.)
column2: (Kendaraan yang bergerak mendadak itu membuat semua orang selain Ateraxis dan Beluga terhuyung. Keduanya seolah melampaui pengaruh gravitasi dan inersia bumi, bertukar serangan dan tangkisan dengan gerakan mengalir yang bahkan tidak bisa ditangkap Doll lain.)

column1: (Chiloveig let out a strange cry and grabbed the Barracuda node that had started sliding because it wasn't secured properly. I seized the opportunity and slammed into her.)
column2: (Chiloveig melepas pekikan aneh dan menangkap node Barracuda yang mulai meluncur karena tidak diikat dengan benar. Aku memanfaatkan kesempatan itu dan menghantamkan diri ke arahnya.)

column1: Sir Knight, I really need to teach you a lesson!
column2: Tuan Knight, aku benar-benar harus memberimu pelajaran!

column1: You stinking dead fish, don't touch our Commander!
column2: Dasar ikan mati bau, jangan sentuh Commander kami!

column1: Alright~ Then let's start with you.
column2: Baiklah~ Kalau begitu kita mulai dari kau.

column1: (Colphne's pistol didn't do much damage to Chiloveig, only barely slowing her down. I quickly drew my combat knife and tried to pry open the tightly sealed canister.)
column2: (Pistol Colphne tidak banyak melukai Chiloveig, hanya sedikit memperlambatnya. Aku cepat menarik pisau tempurku dan mencoba menyongkel tabung yang tersegel rapat itu.)

column1: It's useless. Do you really think they would build a safety device to prevent casualties!
column2: Tidak berguna. Kau benar-benar berpikir mereka memasang perangkat keselamatan untuk mencegah korban!

column1: (A sharp appendage swings down at me. Colphne blocks between me and Chiloveig, who has already become a monster, and her petite Frame is once again thrown away by her.)
column2: (Sebuah tungkai tajam mengayun turun ke arahku. Colphne menghadang di antara aku dan Chiloveig yang sudah jadi monster, dan Frame kecilnya kembali dilempar jauh.)

column1: (The Nyto lunges at me. I vault over the Barracuda and swing my saber, severing an appendage—and at this moment, I notice that the blade is once again flashing with a hint of blue light, just like in the old castle in the Red Zone before.)
column2: (Nyto itu menerjangku. Aku melompati Barracuda dan mengayunkan sabelku, memutus satu tungkainya—dan saat itu aku menyadari bilahnya kembali berkelip cahaya biru samar, sama seperti di kastel tua di Red Zone dulu.)

column1: (Chiloveig cries out in alarm, seemingly intimidated by the weapon in my hand. Then, a sudden hail of bullets makes her let out an even louder scream of agony. The Nyto awkwardly abandons me and scurries to the side.)
column2: (Chiloveig memekik waspada, sepertinya terintimidasi oleh senjata di tanganku. Lalu hujan proyektil yang tiba-tiba membuatnya melepas jeritan kesakitan yang lebih nyaring. Nyto itu meninggalkanku dengan gerakan kikuk dan menyingkir ke samping.)

column1: Commander, the defense forces have returned!
column2: Commander, pasukan pertahanan sudah kembali!

column1: (I peeked out and took a look. Groza, the Zucchero Squad, and other Elmo Dolls had successfully retreated thanks to Asteria's comms. They were also full of surprise at AR-15's assembly, but understood the situation in an instant.)
column2: (Aku menjenguk keluar dan melihat. Groza, Zucchero Squad, dan Doll Elmo lainnya berhasil ditarik kembali berkat komunikasi Asteria. Mereka juga penuh keheranan melihat AR-15 berkumpul lengkap, tapi memahami situasinya dalam sekejap.)

column1: AR Team, we're here to support, hold on!
column2: AR Team, kami datang membantu, bertahanlah!

column1: Springfield, cover me, I'm going to save Helena!
column2: Springfield, lindungi aku, aku akan menyelamatkan Helena!

column1: Understood, Zucchero Squad, suppress Ateraxis!
column2: Dimengerti, Zucchero Squad, tekan Ateraxis!

column1: Peritya, take Yoohee, Florence, Peri, and Qiuhua, continuously destroy that dragon's torso, and deal with Chiloveig.
column2: Peritya, bawa Yoohee, Florence, Peri, dan Qiuhua, hancurkan terus badan naga itu, dan urus Chiloveig.

column1: ...As you wish.
column2: ...Sesuai perintah.

column1: (Since Peritya came in, her eyes had been fixed on Dandelion lying to the side. She nodded to me, then led the Dolls of the mixed echelon to engage in destroying the dragon's body.)
column2: (Sejak masuk, mata Peritya terpaku pada Dandelion yang terbaring di samping. Dia mengangguk padaku, lalu memimpin para Doll eselon campuran itu untuk menghancurkan tubuh naga tersebut.)

column1: Commander, leave Helena to me, you go get Melanie out!
column2: Commander, serahkan Helena padaku, kau keluarkan Melanie!

column1: (Groza ran to my side. We didn't have time to open the tubes, so we could only concentrate the firepower at hand to attempt physical destruction.)
column2: (Groza berlari ke sisiku. Kami tidak punya waktu membuka tabungnya, jadi hanya bisa memusatkan daya tembak yang ada untuk menghancurkannya secara fisik.)

column1: (However, even if it wasn't the Barracuda itself, these facilities were still damn sturdy. Groza had to use a grenade to blow open Helena's tube. And I exhausted my ammo, only managing to pry open a crack in Melanie's tube.)
column2: (Namun meski bukan Barracuda itu sendiri, fasilitas-fasilitas ini tetap kokoh luar biasa. Groza harus memakai granat untuk meledakkan tabung Helena. Dan aku menghabiskan amunisiku, hanya berhasil menyongkel satu celah di tabung Melanie.)

column1: (Seeing Helena being carried out of the tank, I desperately widen the crack on the other tank—and right at this moment, Ateraxis's cold tone sounds behind us.)
column2: (Melihat Helena digotong keluar dari tabungnya, aku mati-matian melebarkan celah di tabung yang lain—dan tepat saat itu, nada dingin Ateraxis berbunyi di belakang kami.)

column1: Commander, this time, you cannot stop destiny.
column2: Commander, kali ini kau tidak bisa menghentikan takdir.

column1: I don't intend to stop destiny...
column2: Aku tidak berniat menghentikan takdir...

column1: What I'm going to do is change destiny.
column2: Yang akan kulakukan adalah mengubah takdir.

column1: (Groza and I exchange a glance and strike simultaneously, kicking and shattering the container holding Melanie.)
column2: (Aku dan Groza bertukar pandang lalu menghantam bersamaan, menendang dan menghancurkan wadah yang mengurung Melanie.)

column1: (Ateraxis closes her eyes as if in prayer, bringing her hands together in front of her chest. A powerful energy pulse sweeps across The Elmo, knocking everyone except herself to the ground.)
column2: (Ateraxis menutup matanya seperti sedang berdoa, merapatkan kedua tangannya di depan dada. Sebuah pulsa energi yang kuat menyapu The Elmo, menjatuhkan semua orang selain dirinya ke lantai.)

column1: (Aside from the wound left by Asteria, she remains completely unscathed in the chaotic battle. On our side, however, even Beluga has suffered two massive wounds that would have caused a normal Doll to shut down long ago.)
column2: (Selain luka yang ditinggalkan Asteria, dia sama sekali tidak tergores dalam pertempuran kacau itu. Sementara di pihak kami, bahkan Beluga sudah menderita dua luka masif yang seharusnya membuat Doll biasa mati sejak lama.)

column1: Damn it, since when did such a monster exist in this world—
column2: Sialan, sejak kapan monster seperti itu ada di dunia ini—

column1: (Beluga is the first to stand up from the ground, but Ateraxis doesn't look back, instead focusing on the Barracuda node whose reading is about to complete.)
column2: (Beluga yang pertama berdiri dari lantai, tapi Ateraxis tidak menoleh, dia justru memusatkan perhatian pada node Barracuda yang pembacaannya hampir selesai.)

column1: (The numbers stopped advancing.)
column2: (Angkanya berhenti bergerak.)

column1: Damn it, just that girl isn't enough. Little Ateraxis~ hurry up and dismantle them all, what are you playing at!?
column2: Sialan, satu anak itu saja tidak cukup. Ateraxis Kecil~ cepat bongkar mereka semua, kau bermain-main apa!?
...Tidak.

column1: It's enough, I can feel it.
column2: Ini cukup, aku bisa merasakannya.

column1: (Ateraxis turned to the dragon, which was no longer in its original form, raised her palm, and injected the energy from her body into the massive dragon's body.)
column2: (Ateraxis menoleh ke naga yang bentuknya sudah tidak asli lagi, mengangkat telapak tangannya, dan menyuntikkan energi dari tubuhnya ke tubuh naga raksasa itu.)

column1: (The mutated and twisted flesh began to restore in a short time, presenting the original form of the dragon. Ateraxis gently hugged its nose, pushed its chin up, and urged the dragon to fly away from The Elmo.)
column2: (Daging yang bermutasi dan bengkok itu mulai pulih dalam waktu singkat, memperlihatkan bentuk asli naga tersebut. Ateraxis memeluk lembut hidungnya, mendorong dagunya naik, dan mendesak naga itu terbang menjauh dari The Elmo.)

column1: Wait for me like a good kid. When I come back, you'll have a lot of family.
column2: Tunggu aku seperti anak baik. Saat aku kembali, kau akan punya banyak keluarga.

column1: (A massive pillar of light rose from around Dandelion, fiercely tearing the sky apart.)
column2: (Sebuah pilar cahaya raksasa naik dari sekitar Dandelion, mencabik langit dengan ganas.)

column1: (It was an intertwining of myriad colors that shouldn't exist in this world, like an aurora from the realm of gods, exceeding the limits of human color perception—)
column2: (Itu adalah jalinan warna-warni yang seharusnya tidak ada di dunia ini, bagai aurora dari ranah para dewa, melampaui batas persepsi warna manusia—)

column1: (The deck of the Elmo seemed to be endowed with life, letting out a desperate wail from the gaps in the steel.)
column2: (Dek Elmo seolah diberi kehidupan, melepas ratapan putus asa dari celah-celah bajanya.)

column1: (The originally indestructible metal deck gradually loosened under the massive tremors. The already stalled Elmo suddenly lit up as bright as day, illuminating the faces of everyone present.)
column2: (Dek logam yang semula tak bisa dihancurkan itu perlahan longgar di bawah getaran masif. Elmo yang sudah berhenti itu tiba-tiba menyala seterang siang, menerangi wajah semua orang yang ada di situ.)

column1: (Ateraxis's eyes were also illuminated by this light. Her face was innocent and calm, with only the brimming anticipation in her eyes, like a spark ignited by a glimmer in a silent forest.)
column2: (Mata Ateraxis juga diterangi cahaya itu. Wajahnya tampak lugu dan tenang, hanya matanya yang meluap penuh harap, seperti bunga api yang tersulut kilauan di hutan yang sunyi.)

column1: (The originally familiar mobile base seemed to be moving forward in some strange, silent, and highly vibrant manner—sailing through this infinitely changing sea of light, heading towards some unknown destination.)
column2: (Pangkalan bergerak yang semula begitu dikenal itu seolah melaju maju dengan cara yang aneh, sunyi, dan penuh gelora—berlayar melewati lautan cahaya yang terus berubah tanpa batas, menuju tujuan yang tidak diketahui.)

column1: (However, when I carefully observe my surroundings and beneath my feet, I am not so sure if I am truly still on The Elmo, or if I have arrived in another world. Beneath my feet is a flowing water surface, and around me is a sea of iridescent, ever-changing Epiphyllums.)
column2: (Namun saat aku mengamati sekelilingku dan bawah kakiku dengan teliti, aku tidak begitu yakin apakah aku benar-benar masih di The Elmo, atau sudah sampai di dunia lain. Di bawah kakiku ada permukaan air yang mengalir, dan di sekelilingku ada lautan bunga wijayakusuma yang berkilau dan terus berubah warna.)

column1: (In an instant, it feels as if a massive amount of 'experiences' flows into my mind, making me feel as though my sense of self is washed away, yet also omnipresent—)
column2: (Dalam sekejap, terasa seolah 'pengalaman' dalam jumlah masif mengalir ke kepalaku, membuatku merasa kesadaran diriku tersapu hilang, tapi sekaligus ada di mana-mana—)

column1: Such a strange feeling... Ugh...
column2: Perasaan yang aneh sekali... Ugh...

column1: What exactly is this!
column2: Sebenarnya ini apa!
Itu...

column1: (All the past and future, all of this moment and the other side, converged into the same whisper at this moment.)
column2: (Semua masa lalu dan masa depan, semua saat ini dan sisi yang lain, menyatu jadi satu bisikan yang sama pada saat itu.)

column1: (I felt countless versions of myself, across countless journeys, simultaneously carrying out an endless cycle of cause and effect.)
column2: (Aku merasakan diriku dalam versi yang tak terhitung, melintasi perjalanan yang tak terhitung, serentak menjalankan lingkaran sebab-akibat tanpa akhir.)

column1: (My senses were swept up by memories that did not belong to this time and place—)
column2: (Panca inderaku disapu ingatan yang bukan milik waktu dan tempat ini—)

column1: (Ecstasy, grief, despair, hope... like a waterfall flowing backwards, roughly pouring into my consciousness.)
column2: (Kegembiraan, duka, keputusasaan, harapan... seperti air terjun yang mengalir balik, mencurah kasar ke kesadaranku.)

column1: (I reached out my hand—it was no longer bound by ropes. In my hand, I held a bloodstained knife, a smoking pistol, a black pen, and... a beautiful ring.)
column2: (Aku mengulurkan tanganku—tangan itu tidak lagi terikat tali. Di tanganku ada pisau berlumur darah, pistol yang mengepul, sebuah pena hitam, dan... sebuah cincin yang indah.)

column1: (Countless threads of light passed through the barriers of time and space, intertwining in my consciousness... ultimately melting deep into my bloodline.)
column2: (Benang cahaya yang tak terhitung menembus batas ruang dan waktu, berjalin di kesadaranku... akhirnya meleleh dalam ke garis darahku.)

column1: (Suddenly, the scenery before my eyes was completely withdrawn, turning into a nothingness that constantly transformed between pale and brilliant.)
column2: (Tiba-tiba pemandangan di depan mataku ditarik sepenuhnya, berubah menjadi ketiadaan yang terus bertukar antara pucat dan gemerlap.)

column1: (Immediately after, I saw—)
column2: (Sesaat kemudian, aku melihat—)

column1: Her
column2: Dia

column1: (She didn't stop me from pulling Melanie out of the tube—she just walked towards the 'Barracuda'.)
column2: (Dia tidak menghentikanku menarik Melanie keluar dari tabung—dia hanya berjalan ke arah 'Barracuda'.)

column1: (Something is indeed happening.)
column2: (Sesuatu memang sedang terjadi.)

column1: (Groza suddenly let out a soft gasp beside me. I shifted my gaze away from Ateraxis, only to see—Dandelion, who should have been lying on the ground, had somehow stood up and blocked Ateraxis's path.)
column2: (Groza tiba-tiba menahan napas lirih di sebelahku. Aku mengalihkan pandangan dari Ateraxis, hanya untuk melihat—Dandelion yang seharusnya terbaring di lantai entah bagaimana sudah berdiri dan menghadang jalan Ateraxis.)

column1: (Ateraxis was about to reach out to Dandelion, but was pushed back by the energy erupting from within the Doll. Chiloveig was even sent flying straight out through the hole in the Elmo.)
column2: (Ateraxis hendak mengulurkan tangan ke Dandelion, tapi terdorong balik oleh energi yang meletus dari dalam Doll itu. Chiloveig bahkan terlempar langsung keluar lewat lubang di Elmo.)

column1: (I held Melanie and retreated together with Groza—the tactical options still available were extremely limited, and I couldn't grasp the situation unfolding before me—except for two already clear realities.)
column2: (Aku memeluk Melanie dan mundur bersama Groza—opsi taktis yang masih ada sangat terbatas, dan aku tidak bisa memahami situasi yang terbentang di depanku—kecuali dua kenyataan yang sudah jelas.)

column1: (The Barracuda did not start smoothly.)
column2: (Barracuda tidak menyala dengan lancar.)

column1: (But the door—is being opened.)
column2: (Tapi pintunya—sedang terbuka.)
